title: Boarding for Dogs Who Are Selective With Other Dogs (Miramar)
keyword: boarding for dogs selective with other dogs
meta: Is your dog picky with other dogs? Four Paws Inn in Miramar takes it slow: one on one time first, small groups only when it fits, and private suites if needed.
body: Is your dog picky with other dogs? Many dogs are. At Four Paws Inn in Miramar, we plan the stay around your dog, not the other way around.
## We start slow
New dogs never go straight into a group. First they get one on one time with us. Then quiet time to explore the house and the yard.
## Groups only when it fits

We take group introductions slowly, when the dog is ready and group care is a good fit. We keep groups small on purpose. Some dogs join in a few hours. Some take a few days. Some do best on their own, and that is ok.
## Private suites
Some dogs are happier with their own space. A private suite is $80 a day per dog for dogs 50 lb and under, and $100 a day for dogs over 50 lb.
## Tell us about your dog
Tell us what your dog is like with other dogs, and with new people. The more we know, the better we can plan. If a dog is not a fit for our home, we tell you kindly and honestly.
## One video update each day
You get one video update of your dog each day, so you can see how the stay is going.
## Ready to book?

Send us your dates and tell us about your dog. Call or text (754) 277 2325, or book at fourpawsinn.co. Want to see the home first? Optional tours are on Tuesdays, 9 AM to 7 PM. Four Paws Inn has 230+ Google reviews and a 4.9 star rating.

title: Large Dog Boarding in Miramar: Room to Run for Dogs Over 50 lb
meta: Large dog boarding in Miramar. Standard rate: $75 a day over 50 lb. Puppy, senior and suite rates differ. One video update each day.
body: Big dogs need room. Four Paws Inn is a family run, cage free dog boarding home in Miramar with a big backyard.
## A real home, not a kennel
Your dog stays in our family home. No kennel rows. Dogs go outside about every hour to play and potty, and they sleep inside a calm house.
## Matched by size and energy
When group care fits your dog, we match playmates by size, energy and play style. New dogs start slow, with one on one time first.
## Price

We charge by the day. Standard boarding is $75 a day for dogs over 50 lb and $60 a day for dogs under 50 lb. Each additional dog is $5 a day less. Pick up before 10 AM and the last day is not charged. Puppy, senior and private suite rates differ. Send your dog's age and weight for your quote.
## No hidden fees
Play, toys and supervised pool time are part of the stay. The price you see is the price you pay.
## What to bring
Food, one meal per Ziploc bag. A leash. Any medicine, with clear notes. We have beds, bowls and toys.
## Ready to book?

Send us your dates and tell us about your dog. Call or text (754) 277 2325, or book at fourpawsinn.co. A 25% deposit holds your dates, and the rest is paid before drop off. Four Paws Inn has 230+ Google reviews and a 4.9 star rating.

title: Boarding Two Dogs Together: How Our Multi Dog Rate Works
meta: Boarding two dogs at Four Paws Inn in Miramar. Siblings always stay together, and each additional dog is $5 a day less. See how the multi dog rate works.
body: Have two dogs? At Four Paws Inn in Miramar, siblings always stay together.
## They stay together
Your dogs keep each other company. If group play fits one dog, they can play and then come back inside to their sibling. The other can stay close and relax.
## How the price works

We charge by the day. Standard boarding for the first dog is $60 a day under 50 lb, or $75 a day over 50 lb. Each additional dog is $5 a day less. Puppy, senior and private suite rates differ. Send your dogs' ages and weights for your quote.
## An example
Two dogs under 50 lb at standard boarding: $60 plus $55, so $115 a day.
## Private suites for two
Siblings can share one private suite. A suite is $80 a day per dog for dogs 50 lb and under, and $100 a day for dogs over 50 lb, with $5 a day less for each additional dog.
## One video update each day
You get one video update of your dogs each day.
## Ready to book?

Send us your dates and tell us about both dogs. Call or text (754) 277 2325, or book at fourpawsinn.co. A 25% deposit holds your dates, and the rest is paid before drop off. Four Paws Inn has 230+ Google reviews and a 4.9 star rating.
